name: bitpoint
tagline: File-based HTTP endpoints for Python, where each file carries its own isolated dependencies
description: bitpoint is a file-based HTTP endpoint framework for Python. Each file defines an endpoint and carries its own isolated dependencies, so a single project can host many small services without dependency conflicts. It is a fresh take on serverless-style routing for Python that keeps deployment simple and reproducible.
highlights: Each file is an endpoint with isolated dependencies
Simple, reproducible deployment for Python backends
MIT-licensed with a clean minimal design
curatorNote: A tiny, opinionated idea — endpoint-per-file with isolated deps — that removes a whole class of Python deployment pain. Early (6 stars) but the design is worth watching.
